tr: Kecelakaanlah bagi setiap pengumpat lagi pencela,
en: Woe to every scorner and mocker
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.

tr: dia mengira bahwa hartanya itu dapat mengkekalkannya,
en: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

tr: sekali-kali tidak! Sesungguhnya dia benar-benar akan dilemparkan ke dalam Huthamah.
en: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.

tr: Dan tahukah kamu apa Huthamah itu?
en: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
Which mounts directed at the hearts.

tr: Sesungguhnya api itu ditutup rapat atas mereka,
en: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them

tr: (sedang mereka itu) diikat pada tiang-tiang yang panjang.
